name: Look up member savings balance
description: Searches for a member by identifier in the servicing console and returns their current savings balance.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Value supplied by the calling agent for 'member_id' at invocation time.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: Value 'savings_balance' as displayed by the application at replay time.

target.rationale: The search field is associated with the visible label 'Member ID', which is the stable, human-meaningful identifier for this input. No accessible name is exposed on the input itself, so the label association is the most durable locator; a CSS/name attribute would be tied to the current legacy markup.

steps.postcondition: The application accepted the action without an error signal.

target.rationale: The submit button is identified by its accessible role and visible name 'Search', which is the stable, human-meaningful identifier for this control and should survive layout or markup changes in future versions of the console.

steps.postcondition: The application accepted the action without an error signal.

target.rationale: The page exposes a stable semantic data-field attribute naming the value cell itself, not the 'Current Balance' label beside it. No accessible role or label association is offered for this value, and data-field='savings-balance' is a narrowly scoped, meaning-carrying attribute that should survive layout changes better than positional or class-based selectors.

steps.postcondition: The declared output is present and non-empty.

checkpoint.description: The member detail page displays the 'Savings Account' section, confirming the balance read came from the savings sub-section of a loaded member record rather than an error or empty page.

locator.rationale: A structural section heading that is present for every member with a savings account, independent of which member was looked up or what their balance is. Asserting on the heading rather than the amount keeps the checkpoint valid for future callers.

business_outcomes.description: No member matches the supplied identifier.

locator.rationale: The application emits a machine-readable outcome attribute. Keying on it rather than on display text survives copy edits and localisation, both of which vary by institution.

business_outcomes.description: The member exists, but this service account may not view them.

locator.rationale: The application emits a machine-readable outcome attribute. Keying on it rather than on display text survives copy edits and localisation, both of which vary by institution.

recovery_rules.description: The servicing host dropped the session. Re-entering at the entry point re-establishes it, after which the flow replays from the start.

detector.rationale: Application-emitted error code, stable across releases.

recovery_rules.description: Transient host error. A reload distinguishes a blip from a real outage without masking a sustained failure.

detector.rationale: Application-emitted error code, stable across releases.

recovery_rules.description: A maintenance notice occasionally covers the page. Safe to dismiss because it carries no business decision — unlike an error, which is telling you something you must not click past.

detector.rationale: Dedicated interstitial marker, distinct from error markers.

dismiss_target.rationale: Accessible role and name; resilient to layout changes.
